chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Jameel ibn Salih, from Yusuf ibn Abu Saeed who said:
I was in the presence of Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) one day,

so he (peace be upon him) said to me: ‘When it will be the Day of Judgement and Allah Blessed and High Gathers the creatures, Noah (peace be upon him) would be the first one to be called. It will be said to him (peace be upon him): ‘Did you preach?’ So he (peace be upon him) will say: ‘Yes’. It will be said to him (peace be upon him): ‘Who will testify for you?’ So he (peace be upon him) will say: ‘Muhammad ibn Abdullah (peace be upon him and his family)’.

So Noah (peace be upon him) would go out and pass over the people until he (peace be upon him) would come to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and he (peace be upon him and his family) would be clothed in the musk, and with him (peace be upon him and his family) would be Ali (peace be upon him), and it is the Statement of Allah Mighty and Majestic: ‘But when they shall see it nigh, the faces of those who disbelieve shall be sorry’.

So Noah (peace be upon him) will say to Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family): ‘O Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)! Allah Blessed and High Questioned me saying: “Did you preach?” I said: ‘Yes’. So He said: “Who will testify for you?’ So I said: ‘Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)’. So he (peace be upon him and his family) will say: ‘O Ja’far (peace be upon him), O Hamza (peace be upon him), go and testify for him (peace be upon him and his family) that he (peace be upon him and his family) did preach’.

So Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) said: ‘Thus Ja’far (peace be upon him) and Hamza (peace be upon him) are the two witnesses for the Prophets (peace be upon them) of what they (peace be upon them) had preached’.
So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you (peace be upon him), so where will Ali (peace be upon him) be?’ He (peace be upon him) said: ‘He (peace be upon him) is of a status greater than that’.
ai.seo_question: Who testifies for Prophet Noah on the Day of Judgement according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the unique intercessory role of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) as the primary witness for the Prophets' conveyance of divine messages, a concept rooted in Quranic verses describing him as a witness over mankind. The narrative emphasizes the hierarchical spiritual status within the Ahl al-Bayt, noting that while Ja'far al-Sadiq and Hamza serve as witnesses for all Prophets, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) possesses a superior rank, reflecting the Shia belief in his preeminent position among the faithful. This scene illustrates the continuity of prophetic mission and the pivotal role of the Imams in validating the truth of previous revelations on the Day of Judgment.
